day_local: NgoLwesibini weVeki yamashumi amathathu ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Uxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, uthando lukaThixo, kunye nokuzalana koMoya oyiNgcwele makube nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi ngenxa yokuba sonile. Sibonise, Nkosi, inceba yakho. Usinike usindiso lwakho.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengemifanekiso esiyibona kwii-albhamu zakudala—imifanekiso enombala oqaqambileyo, kodwa ebonakala ngathi yeyexesha elidlulileyo. Ucinga ngelo xesha xa uBen wayesahleli phakathi kwenu, mhlawumbi ebukele iinqwelo-moya eziphakama, okanye ecinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe awayeyithanda kakhulu. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayengajongi nje ubomi njengendlela yokufika kwindawo ethile, kodwa njengohambo olumangalisayo. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, umfana owayefunda iikhowudi ze-AI kwaye ecinga ngendlela yokulawula iinkqubo ezinkulu zeteknoloji, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukufunda 'iimpawu zexesha' ngendlela eyodwa. Wayengumfana owayesazi ukuba nini apho umzuzu ubalulekile, nini apho kufuneka uncume, kwaye nini apho kufuneka ubonise uthando olunzulu.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu usibuza umbuzo othi: 'Ubukumkani bukaThixo bunjengantoni? Ndingabufanisa nani?' UYesu usebenzisa umfanekiso wembewu yesinaphi, imbewu encinci kakhulu, kodwa ekhula ibe ngumthi omkhulu apho iintaka zisakha khona iindlwane. Uphinda asebenzise umfanekiso we-yeast—igwele—elixutywa nofulawa, lize linyuse intlama yonke. Masiyimele kancinci le mfanekiso… Imbewu yesinaphi ayizange yathembisa ukuba iya kuba ngumthi okhulu ngosuku olulodwa. Igwele alizange lithembise ukuba intlama iya kunyuka ngomzuzu omnye. Konke oku kufuna ixesha, ukuzola, nokuthemba ukuba uThixo uyasebenza nangona singaboni nto isenzekayo.

Ubenjamine wayeyimbewu enjalo. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayikhula kuthando, eyayifunda ukunika, kwaye eyayikwazi ukubona ubuhle kuyo yonke into. Khumbula loo mfanekiso mhle wosapho lapho uBen, eneminyaka eli-15 nje kuphela, wathetha nabazali bakhe ngokuba wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yasebhange yakhe encinci ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam owayehlaselwe yimivumbo. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube yemali, yayingekho imfuneko yokuba ayiphule ngenxa yokuba umalume wayene-inshurensi, kodwa loo mnikelo wangoqobo, lowo mbono womntwana owayezimiseleyo ukunikela ngako konke okwakhe ngaphandle kokubala, usixelela ukuba uBen wayenesipho esikhulu sothando olungenamiqathango. Loo mnikelo wawungumfanekiso wothando lukaKristu olungaphezulu kolwazi.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane minne idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu, zikushiya ungazi nokuba ume ngaphi. Kukho amandla emphefumlo aphelileyo, kukho ubusuku obude lapho ukungabikho kwesitulo sikaBen okanye ukungaphulaphuli kwakhe amabanga ayethethwa nguyise kubangela isikhewu esingazalisekiyo. Kodwa mamela le nyaniso namhlanje: uThixo akamlibalanga uBen, kwaye akakubalelanga nani. Kwizinto ezenzekayo ebudeni bokugula, abazali abaninzi bazithwala ngokwabo umthwalo wokuzisola: 'Ngaba kukhona endinokukwenza ngcono? Ngaba ndiphosile?' Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

KwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usixelela: 'Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ loved the Church and handed himself over for her.' (Madoda, thandani abafazi benu, njengoko uKristu wathandayo iCawa wazinikela ngenxa yayo). Oku akusebenzi nje kumtshato, kodwa kusebenza kulo lonke uthando olungcwele. UBen wazinikela ngothando lwakhe—ngoncumo lwakhe, ngobukrelekrele bakhe, nangobubele bakhe. Wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukuba uthando alukho malunga nokufumana, kodwa malunga nokunikela. UBen wayengumfana owayengalindi ukuba izinto zenzeke; wayeyindoda encinci eyayithatha inyathelo lothando ngaphandle kokuzigcina nto. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo ne-AI, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sabangcwele abasifundisa ukuba nibe nesibindi sokuma ngenxa kaKristu, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
petitions: Sikhulekela uBenjamin Vo kunye nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu, sithandaza kwiNkosi.

spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kule Sakramente yeAltare. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwazo zonke izinto, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokusemthethweni, nceda uze kum ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, ndimanyane nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine kwaye isikhokelele kuxolo lwayo. Amen.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwana nodade bethu: Thobelanani ngokoyika uKristu. Abafazi mabathobele amadoda abo njengokuba bethobela iNkosi. Kuba indoda iyintloko yomfazi wayo, njengokuba uKristu eyintloko yeCawa, engumsindisi womzimba. Njengokuba iCawa ithobela uKristu, abafazi mabathobele amadoda abo ezintweni zonke. Madoda, thandani abafazi benu, njengokuba uKristu wayithandayo iCawa wazinikela ngenxa yayo, ukuze ayingcwalise, eyihlambulula ngesihlambe samanzi ngelizwi, ukuze azimisele kuye iCawa eqaqambileyo, engenabala nambimbi, okanye nantoni na enjalo, ukuze ibe ngcwele, ingenasiphako. Ngoko ke amadoda mabawathande abafazi bawo njengemizimba yawo. Lowo umthanda umfazi wakhe uzithanda yena. Kuba akukho mntu uthye inyama yakhe, kodwa uyondla, ayigcine, njengokuba uKristu eyenza kwiCawa, kuba singamalungu omzimba wakhe. Ngenxa yoko, indoda iya kushiya uyise nonina, izibambele kumfazi wayo, babe mnye umzimba. Le yimfihlakalo enkulu, kodwa ndithetha ngoKristu neCawa. Noko ke, elowo kuni makamthande umfazi wakhe njengoko ezithanda yena, umfazi ke makamhlonele indoda yakhe.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Banoyolo abo boyika iNkosi. Banoyolo abo boyika iNkosi, abahamba ezindleleni zayo! Uya kudla umvuzo womsebenzi wezandla zakho; uya kuba noyolo, uya kuba nempumelelo. R. Banoyolo abo boyika iNkosi. Umfazi wakho uya kuba njengomdiliya ovelisayo ezindlwini zakho; abantwana bakho njengemithi yomnquma ejikeleze itafile yakho. R. Banoyolo abo boyika iNkosi. Niyabona, banoyolo abo boyika iNkosi. INkosi mayikusikelele iseZiyon: mayikubone ukuchuma kweJerusalem yonke imihla yobomi bakho. R. Banoyolo abo boyika iNkosi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi, 'Ubukumkani bukaThixo bunjengantoni? Ndingabufanisa nani? Bunjengembewu yesinaphi, eyathatyathwa ngumntu wayityala egadini yakhe. Yakhula, yaba ngumthi omkhulu, iintaka zezulu zakha iindlwane emasebeni ayo.' Waphinda wathi, 'Ndingabufanisa nani ubukumkani bukaThixo? Bunjengegwele elathatyathwa ngumfazi, walixuba kwiimilinganiselo ezintathu zomgubo wengqolowa, kwada kwavuka intlama yonke.'

day: Tuesday of the Thirtieth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
